cards.evidence: 21 listings (65.6% of catalog) with average rating 4.28 ★.
cards.limitations: Pricing power depends heavily on high-quality product photography and explicit fabric thickness bullet points in your listing.
cards.why_this: Shoppers seeking daily work and college wear prefer breathable cotton with dependable opacity over budget synthetic alternatives prone to return penalties.
cards.suggested_action: Worth investigating: launch new product at ₹849–₹899 with an introductory coupon to capture quality-conscious daily wear buyers.

cards.evidence: 16 listings observed utilizing Cotton with top review conversion.
cards.limitations: Cotton requires pre-shrinking treatment to prevent customer return complaints regarding shrinkage after washing.
cards.why_this: Customer review analysis in Eastern India reveals that breathability and non-see-through fabric are the primary positive review drivers.
cards.suggested_action: Worth investigating: source 60s count pure combed cotton in Indigo Blue and Maroon with floral or Sambalpuri yoke prints.
